landing.headline: Appointments, patients, finance and messaging for your clinic
landing.body: A secure workspace for clinic owners, reception, cashiers and doctors.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password for your staff account.
login.errorInvalid: Enter a valid email and password.

overview.title: Overview
overview.pendingNotice: This clinic is waiting for licence verification. Appointments, consultations and patient messages stay disabled until the platform approves it.
overview.suspendedNotice: This clinic is suspended. Contact the platform team.
overview.noClinicBody: Your account is not an active member of any clinic. Ask the clinic owner for an invitation, or contact them if your access was suspended.
overview.closedNotice: This clinic is closed. Its records are archived and kept.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Clinic owners and invited staff each use their own personal account.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper- and lower-case letters and a digit.
register.confirmEmail: Check your email and open the confirmation link, then sign in to continue.

newClinic.title: Register a clinic
newClinic.description: You will be the clinic owner. The clinic stays pending until the platform verifies its licences.
newClinic.name: Clinic name
newClinic.acceptDisclaimer: I have read and accept this notice on behalf of the clinic.

onboarding.ownerOnly: Only the clinic owner can manage licences.
onboarding.title: Licences & verification
onboarding.pendingIntro: Upload the clinic operating licence and the doctor's professional licence. The platform team reviews them before the clinic can start operating.

stateIntro.active: Your clinic is verified and active.
stateIntro.suspended: Your clinic is suspended. Contact the platform team.

onboarding.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
onboarding.uploaded: Uploaded. It will be reviewed by the platform team.

staff.noAccess: You don't have permission to manage staff in this clinic.
staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteDescription: The invitation link works once, for 7 days, and only for the invited email address.
staff.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Send this link to the employee — it is shown only once:
staff.deactivateHint: Access ends immediately. Deactivation cannot be undone; history is kept.
staff.permissionsDescription: Only you, as owner, can assign roles and change permissions.
staff.managerCanManageStaff: Managers can invite, suspend and deactivate receptionists, cashiers and doctors.

invite.title: Clinic invitation
invite.description: Join a clinic workspace with your personal account.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to.
invite.summary: You are invited to join {clinic} as {role}.

status.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
status.used: This invitation has already been used.
status.revoked: This invitation was cancelled by the clinic.
status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the clinic for a new one.
status.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.reasonOptionalForApproval: Reason (required to reject or request a replacement)
admin.activateHint: Activation requires both licences approved. The 14-day trial starts now.
